value.rationale: The source resolves undecidability but leaves the exact arithmetical level unstated. Pi-zero-one-completeness is a materially stronger classification: it identifies the optimal semidecidability direction and rules out recursive enumerability of validities. Propagating the same exact level to both extremal modal companions gives a natural three-logic closure of the new result.
